description: The chart, Figure 19, illustrates the average probing accuracy using different MLP variations, comparing the performance of mBERT and XLM-R models across various configurations. The x-axis contains the categories, labeled with different MLP variations, including the size(s) of hidden layer(s) in square brackets, and is ordered as "hidden:[50], linear", "hidden:[], linear", "hidden:[100], ReLU", and "hidden:[50, 50], ReLU". The y-axis represents the "% point difference" with a linear scale, ranging from -0.2 to 0.2, and is labeled with tick marks at intervals of 0.1. The chart features grouped bars, with each group representing a different MLP variation, and within each group, there are two bars, one for mBERT (light blue) and one for XLM-R (dark blue). The bars for mBERT have approximate values of 0.0, 0.08, -0.08, and -0.18, while the bars for XLM-R have approximate values of -0.08, 0.2, 0.05, and -0.2, respectively. The chart does not display any specific sorting order for the bars, and no bars are visually emphasized.
